note: 迷宫纪 1001 年那一套的左右两扇。11-03 probe：这台电脑只装了 Anima preview3（UNET、qwen_3_06b 文本编码器、qwen_image VAE），没有 checkpoint、ControlNet、LoRA、放大模型，也没有 IPAdapter 节点，所以 config 走 anima 一路，构图只靠彩色底稿图生图，线稿和风格参照图没用上。采样器、CFG 照官方 Anima 模板；区域提示试过，每块一百八十像素上下，Anima 画不出人还碎成方块，关了（regions 留着，换模型再开）；提示词用 prompt_flux 那段自然语言，画风词放进 prompt_prefix。左扇 denoise 从 0.8 调到 0.85，低了太平，走 run。右扇整幅一次分不开九个人，走 comp（comfy_run.py comp），jobs 里它那一段 init、line、prompt_flux、denoise 这一路不用。左扇左边是外侧、右边贴窗，右扇反过来；贴窗那一边七十像素给花边切，上下各一成给裁。

jobs.prompt_flux: A tall vertical fantasy illustration in the style of an anime JRPG key visual, painterly cel shading with fine gold line outlines on cream and gold, art-nouveau filigree and teal swirls. Seven deities, each framed by a golden circular halo, rise in a staggered column like stained-glass medallions. From top to bottom: a wind goddess with white feathered wings and wild golden hair holding a bow; a red-haired god whose wings braid fire, ice mist and lightning, holding an elemental staff; a towering god whose body is half immortal stone, with rocky wings like layered mountain ridges, holding a great earth hammer; a small child goddess with tiny fawn antlers, vines and a halo of seeds, holding a sickle; a smiling goddess of luck with golden bells and floating coins and a black cat on her shoulder; a gentle healing goddess with jade-green eyes and small white wings on top of her head, holding a holy spear; a calm god of war in a plain robe with dangerous eyes, holding a sword. Below them stand two queens side by side: on the left a crowned queen with deep bronze-gold hair and pale gold eyes in white and gold armor with a longsword; on the right a queen with long silver-grey hair, golden eyes, pale skin and a small red mark on her forehead, in black and crimson robes with a dark divine aura and a scepter. At the bottom, a white city with airships among swirling clouds. Cream, gold and teal palette with crimson accents, no text.
